now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#6
now.text: Enoch offers Jemma up to the Chronicom hunters to make Fitz cooperate, then turns on his own people and rescues her and Fitz.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Agent Enoch first betrays to the hunters, then rescues.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Chronicom who betrays Jemma to the hunters, then rescues her and Fitz.

proposed.text: Enoch warns Atarah that her mind machine is too dangerous for Jemma and Fitz. Told to choose between his people and his friends, he chooses his friends, knocks out the Chronicoms and helps the two escape.

changes.evidence: Enoch offering Jemma up to Atarah (telling her to put Simmons in danger to motivate Fitz) happens in The Other Thing (S6#5), not Inescapable (S6#6). In Inescapable, Enoch warns Atarah the Cerebral Fusion Machine could kill them, is told to pick a side, chooses his friends, deactivates Atarah, Malachi and the other Chronicoms, and teleports away with Fitz and Simmons.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#6
now.text: Enoch offers Jemma up to the Chronicom hunters, and a furious Fitz throws him out of his cell, but Enoch then turns on his own people to rescue them both.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Best friend Enoch betrays, then rescues from the hunters.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Chronicom who betrays Jemma to the hunters, then rescues Fitz and her.

proposed.text: Enoch warns Atarah that her mind machine is too dangerous for Fitz and Jemma. Told to choose between his people and his friends, he chooses his friends, knocks out the Chronicoms and helps the two escape.

changes.evidence: Enoch offering Jemma up and the furious Fitz ordering him out of his cell (before Enoch gasses him) both happen in The Other Thing (S6#5). In Inescapable (S6#6), Enoch warns Atarah the machine is dangerous, chooses his friends over his people, deactivates the Chronicoms and escapes with Fitz and Simmons.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
now.text: Jemma has saved May's life before, curing her after a ghost's touch nearly kills her. When Sarge fatally stabs May, Jemma injects her with a healing formula and freezes her in a cryo chamber to keep her alive.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend Jemma has saved before and freezes to keep alive.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who saved May once and freezes her to save her life.

proposed.text: With May dying from Sarge's stab wound, Jemma arrives with a team, injects her with a healing formula and freezes her in a cryo chamber to keep her alive.

changes.evidence: The first sentence tells another episode's event: Simmons (with Radcliffe) stops and restarts May's heart after Lucy Bauer's ghost touch in Uprising (S4#3), with no stage there. In New Life (S6#13), Simmons arrives at the temple, says she has injected May with a formula that will heal her, and has her put in a Cryo-Freeze Chamber.
